title: Lagrangian structures on the derived moduli of constructible sheaves
summary: Given a compact oriented manifold of dimension $n$ with a conically smooth stratification, we show that the moduli of $\mathcal{D}(k)$-valued constructible sheaves and the moduli of perverse sheaves are $(2-n)$-shifted Lagrangian. The former statement follows from the construction of a relative left $n$-Calabi--Yau structure on the stable $\infty$-category of $\mathcal{D}(k)$-valued constructible sheaves.
